Update: Nov 12th, 2026 09:03 EST 0 Share facebook twitter whatsapp Make us preferred on Google In the U.S., certain Social Security beneficiaries are due to be paid next week , as the Social Security Administration (SSA) continues the program’s three-Wednesdays payment cycle for November 2026 .
 Who gets Social Security on Wednesday, Nov. 18?
 Across America, many of the 71.7 million recipients of Social Security benefits are paid on the second, third or fourth Wednesday in each month. Under this system, a beneficiary’s designated payment date depends on their birthday.
 As it is this month’s third Wednesday, November 18 will see benefits sent out to recipients born between the 11th and 20th of any month .
 Next week’s payment run follows a slightly ahead-of-schedule start to November’s three-Wednesdays cycle. Because the second Wednesday in the month fell on the Veterans Day holiday, beneficiaries born between the first and the 10th of any month got their November money a day earlier than usual, on Tuesday 10 .
 November’s full three-Wednesdays cycle is:
 Born on 1st-10th of month: Tuesday, Nov. 10 
 Born on 11th-20th of month: Wednesday, Nov. 18 
 Born on 21st-31st of month: Wednesday, Nov. 25 
 NB: If you claim Social Security based on someone else’s work history, the SSA uses the other person’s date of birth to determine your designated Wednesday.
 What other Social Security payment dates are there in Nov. 2026?
 November 18 will be the third of four payment dates on the SSA’s Social Security schedule for November. 
 Early last week, the agency issued benefits to two groups of recipients who, each month, are paid their money outside of the three-Wednesdays payment cycle:
 Nov. 3: Social Security sent to dual recipients and certain long-term beneficiaries 
 On Tuesday 3 , November’s Social Security benefits were distributed to individuals who began receiving their payments before May 1997 . 
 Tuesday 3 was also this month’s Social Security payment date for beneficiaries who simultaneously claim Supplemental Security Income (SSI).
 A needs-based benefit for certain low-income, low-resource Americans , SSI is separate to the Social Security program, despite also being run by the SSA. 
 Unlike Social Security, applicants to the SSI scheme do not have to earn work credits to qualify. Worth a monthly average of $735.86, SSI was paid out for November on Friday, October 30 . 
 Social Security benefits - average monthly amounts:
 Retirement: $2,037.84 
 Disability: $1,500.84 
 Survivor: $1,636.75 
 Source: The SSA’s ‘ monthly statistical snapshot ’ for Oct. 2026.
 How much is the 2027 COLA?
 In a bid to protect beneficiaries’ purchasing power, the SSA announced last month that it is to raise Social Security and SSI amounts by 3.6% in 2027 . 
 Across all Social Security recipients, this translates into a rise of about $70 on the current average payment , which stands at $1,946.23 per month.
 How does Social Security make payments?
 Direct deposit 
 Beneficiaries of the Social Security scheme can supply the SSA with their bank details using the online “ my Social Security ” tool.
 Direct Express 
 Money can be loaded onto the Direct Express Card , a special debit card for federal disbursements made to recipients who do not have a bank account. Sign up for Direct Express at 1-800-333-1795 or 1-800-772-1213, or at a Social Security office.
